comparison.objective: Measure two level scoops of powdered formula into a bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Scoop granular material, strike each scoop level against a bar, and pour accurately.
comparison.success_condition: Both scoops must be properly leveled, total mass must remain within tolerance, and spills or excess powder fail.
comparison.reason: This tests volumetric measurement and granular handling; free particles are intentionally poured. The candidate instead must retain every ball within a circulating bearing assembly during a constrained slide.
